description: This file defines the IClusterMembershipService interface, which provides methods for querying and managing cluster membership status, including retrieving snapshots, updates, refreshing membership, and killing silos.

classes.name: IClusterMembershipService
classes.description: Interface for cluster membership querying and management functionalities.

methods.name: CurrentSnapshot
methods.description: Property to get the most recent cluster membership snapshot.

methods.name: MembershipUpdates
methods.description: Property to get an enumerable collection of membership updates.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Method to refresh cluster membership if it is not at or above the specified minimum version.

methods.name: TryKill
methods.description: Method to unilaterally declare a specified silo as defunct and attempt to evict it.
